subject.title: Add grouped Claw schema and read-only add plan

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this grouped Claw v1 schema and read-only planning surface in core now, and what stable install-identity/ownership contract must downstream mutation slices preserve?
rationale: The patch is intentionally a foundation for agent, workspace, package, MCP, cron, and removal lifecycle work; choosing its permanent core boundary and identity semantics cannot be safely inferred from tests or a read-only preview alone.

options.title: Approve the experimental core base
options.body: Accept the v1 read-only schema and plan as the core foundation, with explicit follow-up ownership for immutable install identity before mutation semantics expand.

options.title: Resolve lifecycle contract first
options.body: Keep this PR open until the RFC owners agree the core lifecycle and immutable install-identity boundary, then rebase and make the approved decision visible in the implementation.

options.title: Move the concept outside core
options.body: Prefer an external plugin or ClawHub package shape if maintainers decide the grouped lifecycle should not become a bundled core contract.

recommendation.title: Resolve lifecycle contract first
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open until the RFC owners agree the core lifecycle and immutable install-identity boundary, then rebase and make the approved decision visible in the implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Raised the lifecycle and immutable-identity concern in the review discussion and is the strongest available product-boundary routing signal.
